'''Jelka Godec''' (born 21 November 1969) is a Slovenian politician. She has been a member of the [[National Assembly (Slovenia)|National Assembly]] since 2022, having previously served from 2014 to 2020.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.dz-rs.si/wps/portal/Home/pos/pp/izbranP?idOsebe=P252|title=Jelka Godec|publisher=[[National Assembly (Slovenia)|National Assembly]]|language=sl}}</ref> From 2020 to 2022, she served as state secretary of the [[Prime Minister of Slovenia|Office of the Prime Minister]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.zvezoskop.si/en/people/85/|title=Jelka Godec|work=Zvezoskop}}</ref>
